title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode1 Leo/need's Debut Song

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Shindo is currently in a meeting.
I'll have him come over once it's finished. I ask that you have a seat and wait patiently in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you a little too giddy?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But he said he wanted to talk to all of us. Doesn't that mean it's something important?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
True.
We have only been talking to each other through email and video meetings lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something important...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if there's been a new development with regards to our debut?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
So far, all we know is the date he told us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What else could it be...? Maybe we get to perform in that festival?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Both are very exciting prospects.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you have a point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for Mr. Shindo to get here.
Thank you for coming all this way today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds like Mr. Shindo's finished with his other meeting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That means he should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Huh...?
Please give them my regards. We have high hopes for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why does that person seem so familiar...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here.
Perfect. Allow me to introduce you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is Mr. Shimizu, one of the producers for Starry Music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Starry Music...?
As in THE Starry Music...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew I'd seen you somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Leo/need!
Hello, my name is Shimizu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It's nice to meet you as well.
We're Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to finally meet all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: I heard that you're going to be playing in Jam Fest. I couldn't believe it when I heard you're already slated to perform in it before making your debut.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: I wish you all the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, we plan to do our very best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
We get to play in that festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, we'll discuss that in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry, Shindo.
I didn't mean to spill the beans like that.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
But we have very high hopes for you.
After all, you were handpicked by Shindo here.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: And he's been a huge help so far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I appreciate the compliment.
And I'm definitely happy about receiving such a big opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line: Haha. Call it a win-win.

rows.Speaker: Shimizu
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time. I need to get going...
Again, everyone, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Thank you very much!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That was kind of a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I mean, this is a huge company we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
More importantly, Mr. Shindo!
We really get to play at that festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ah, yes. We came to a decision just the other day during an internal meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On one hand, there is still quite a lot you need to work on as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But on the other, Ms. Mochizuki's rapid growth over such a short period coupled with your incredible sound made us believe that you'll be ready by the day of.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You have plenty of time until Jam Fest, so my hope is that you'll be able to use that time to gain more experience and make improvements.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We did it, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There's also another important matter I need to discuss with you all today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like to start working on Leo/need's debut single.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our debut single?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
Some marketing decisions were also made during the meeting I just mentioned, meaning it's now time to take this step.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
Well, we are going to need a single if we're going to make our debut.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
And we gotta make it a good one!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I'd like to make an additional request regarding that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: An additional request...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like for you two to write it together, Ms. Tenma, Ms. Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I'll write the lyrics and Saki will come up with the music like always...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I'm talking about you two doing both of those things together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: What...?
